thig7.3:1.1:
Upacālā:
Having mindfulness, having an eye that sees,
thig7.3:1.4:
of which worthless people
don’t partake.
thig7.3:2.1:
Māra:
Why don’t you approve of birth?
thig7.3:2.2:
One who is born
enjoys sensual pleasures.
thig7.3:3.1:
Upacālā:
For one who is born
there’s death,
thig7.3:4.1:
But there is
the Rightly Awakened One,
thig7.3:4.2:
the undefeated one,
born in the Sakyan clan.
thig7.3:5.4: leading to the stilling of stress.
thig7.3:6.2:
I dwell, delighting
in his bidding.
thig7.3:7.4:
that you have been,
End-maker,
struck down.
